name: Fix multiple listener index shift and once exception bugs in EventEmitter
description: Fix listener unregistration index shift bug in off() and unhandled listener exception bug in once() in src/event-emitter.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Fix two related bugs in src/event-emitter.ts: 1) In off(event, listener), removing multiple listeners causes index shifting that skips removal or throws; ensure all matching listener instances are removed cleanly. 2) In once(event, listener), if the listener throws an exception during execution, it must still be removed from the listener list so it does not fire again on subsequent emits. All tests in test/event-emitter.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: off removes all matching listener instances cleanly
once unregisters the listener even if the listener callback throws
